from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowData(BaseModel):
    """Cash flow amounts for one company from a single filing period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    operating_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from operating activities; positive for inflow, negative for outflow")
    financing_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from financing activities; positive for inflow, negative for outflow")
    operating_label: str | None = Field(description="The label used in the filing for operating cash flow")
    financing_label: str | None = Field(description="The label used in the filing for financing cash flow")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_data: list[CashFlowData]
